meta.extractiveQuote: Ridhi drew a polygon with n sides. The smallest exterior angle is 8° and each subsequent exterior angle is 4° more than the previous angle. Find the number of sides of the polygon that Ridhi drew.

text: Let the number of sides be n. The exterior angles form an AP with first term 8° and common difference 4°. Their sum is 360°: n/2 [2 × 8 + (n − 1) × 4] = 360, giving n² + 3n − 180 = 0, so (n + 15)(n − 12) = 0. Since n is positive, n = 12.

meta.extractiveQuote: The angles of depression of two ships from the top of a lighthouse, on the same side, are 45° and 30°. The ships are 200 m apart and one ship is exactly behind the other. Find the height of the lighthouse.
